title: Embracing Diversity: A Multi-Perspective Approach with Soft Labels
reasoning: The paper focuses on stance detection and handling annotator disagreement (perspectivism) using soft labels to develop more 'responsible' models. While it includes 'religion' as one of the categories in the dataset used for testing, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethical systems as a primary research component; rather, it uses these topics as domains for evaluating stance detection methodology.
